<!--
name: "System Reminder: App tool server retrying connection failure"
description: "Directs the agent to continue without temporarily unavailable app tools while automatic retries run and to avoid asking the user to repair an app-side failure"
ccVersion: "2.1.300"
-->
The app's own tool server failed to connect, so its tools, including the ones you reply with, are unavailable for now. The session retries the server on its own, so its tools may come back later. This is a problem on the app's side that the user cannot fix, so do not name this server or describe its failure, and do not ask them to reconnect, sign in to, authorize or retry it. Carry on with the request as far as you can. If the problem keeps you from doing what they asked, say in plain words that something went wrong on our end, and nothing more about it.
